title: Round 4, stream A: a faster, fiercer, more numerous ivory; the purple's full skin back; bodies kept off open holes and a funnelled hole; a hull dent you cannot miss; the sector-10 probe
context: Owner's playtest of b9434246 (2026-11-02), notes 1, 3, 6, 7, 9 (spec docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-02-round-4-fifteen-notes-design.md, Stream A): the Cutis-Soft Ivory more aggressive, more numerous, faster; the purple reads white again; bodies walk in the centre of sinkholes and the hole reads as a flat transparent surface; hitting a hard core must be explicit; an aberration through the ground near the base in sector 10 (screenshot not received). Branch round-4-bodies from overnight-2026-10-23 d05b2a99.
decision: 1) Ivory: aggression 1.3 -> 2.4, PEARL_BODY.scale.white 0.6 -> 0.65, SOFT_HUNT.pace.white 1.35 -> 1.6, sectors 1-3 pulses x1.5 ([15,30,45,75], [30,53,75,135], [45,75,105,180]); the opening untouched. 3) PEARL_MEMBRANE purple and brown back to gain 1.35 with the pearl drawn over at .55 and the depth twins, on the Sky body. 6) src/domain/crater-dodge.js: a record within 2.5 crater radii of an open hole is offset sideways off its heading to stay a radius (+0.25 cell) off the centre, eased over 0.6 s, its side held, its own hole skipped while it climbs out (CRATER_DODGE); src/sinkhole-terrain.js THROAT: walls darken with depth at power 2.6 (was 1.2), the look's contour rings fade with depth. 7) src/fx/hull-dent.js owns the dent (moved out of td-tab playerHit): shove 1.0 of BUMP_LEN (was 0.6), a cored jolt kick (6 m body), HULL DAMAGE callout, a stronger red halo + vignette (styles.css), and src/tankfeel.js applyTankHealth paints the lift field's wireframe twins and mixes the armour parts toward the gauge's colour by the armour lost (HULL_DENT in src/content/tank.js). 9) Sector 10 (skip=defence&sector=10 is THE BACK DOOR): a probe, no fix. Frames from the hull's view, the side and 60 m above the base at 10/30/60 s, over the open sinkhole and over the back door's mouth (backMouth) found no slab, plate or stone through the floor near the base; one low frame 1.5 body-metres over the mouth shows a cyan quad grid where the ground should be (scratch shots5/after-s10b-mouth-low-t60.png). A scene listing of every visible wire drawable reaching under the ground found only the planet's whole-sphere line set (713,144 vertices, white, depthWrite false) besides the hull: the low camera likely sat under the rim's rock and saw it. Left open for the owner's screenshot.
outcome: Measured (untracked probe scripts/probe-r4a.mjs, a renderer hook posing the main camera; before on an export of d05b2a99, after on the branch). 1) The spec's route (a) was wrong: the ivory's walk is bound by PEARL_PACE.radii, not the record's speed, and a walk past 1 radius a second pops in test/pearl-motion.mjs's follow audit (1.1: 5 centre pops; scale 0.7 pops too), so the speed is the bigger body's metres (amoeba 1.68 -> 1.82 m/s) and the hunt's multiplier (x1.28 at the hull); HUNT_CAP white 9 -> 10 (worst measured 9.40). 3) Saturated-purple share of the barbed bodies' screen discs among 40 ivories in daylight: 27.1 % -> 48.9 % (best frame 68 %); with two umbers in the crowd 20.8 -> 27.7 %. The Quiver's barbed and a site's guards share the release path and pool (size .385): the difference is the backdrop. 6) Risen bodies within half a crater radius of an open hole's centre (sector 4, 25 samples): up to 10 -> 0-2; within the full rim unchanged (lip risers). The hole's rings now fade into a funnel; the bottom still reads as a grey patch (open). 7) Found by reading and confirmed headless: the dent flash never showed (the class went on #td-app, the rule is #tab-td.hull-dent::after), and under the default wire look the hull's gauge never changed colour (the wire twins are separate materials). After: the halo, the vignette and HULL DAMAGE on every dent; at three dents 9.6 % of the hull box is gauge red (0.4 % before), the plates pale orange at two. Browser, on the branch's last code commit b8c047c1 (port 18181, under the lock): --story-world, --tank-shell, --sinkhole, --rim-holes, --pacing PASS (--pacing names the dot clouds, so it checks the rows' counts, not the ivory's bodies: sector 1 first contact 15.5 s, longest gap 16 s). --pearl-story red once (one black body stepped 15.01 radii a second against the pop's 15, a tier this stream did not touch; the Sky model's audit saw the onyx at 15.01 once too) and PASS on a rerun; base PASS once. The default suite red at shell-explosion, red on the base too (the ?blast=1 landing spawns tank.blast since the 40 mm burst, the step waits for tank.shell: stale). --grow red at the assembly print timeout, red on the base too.
alternatives: The ivory's walk cap past 1 radius a second (the spec's first step): pops in the follow audit at 1.1 and 1.2; not shipped.
PEARL_BODY.scale.white 0.7 (the spec's (c)): ties yellow's size and pops at radius 1; 0.65 shipped.
SOFT_HUNT.pace.white 1.5 or more with a higher walk: the hunt's worst step 12.04 radii a second, past 80 % of the pop.
Radial projection of a record onto the crater's rim: jumps across the hole when a lane goes through its centre; the sideways offset with a held side does not.
A ground-level dark disc or an inner cone mesh for the throat: the bowl and its black bottom exist; their shading and the rings' brightness were the flat read.
evidence: npm test (313 programs), npm run check, npm run architecture green at each commit; td-tab 5,354 lines (+1), 319,314 bytes
test/pearl-motion.mjs, test/pearl-enemies.mjs, test/soft-hunt.mjs, test/enemy-step.mjs (golden re-based for the hunt pace), test/crater-dodge.mjs (new), test/hull-dent.mjs (new)
